description:
Imani does not want to see her astronomy exam. She wants to guess it, one question at a time. Professor Okafor answers honestly. The exam on his desk has a lot to say. Her friend Leo is very calm about all of it.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #college
tiktok_caption: guessing my exam grade without looking at it 📚 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #college

lines.text: Professor, do not show me my grade. I want to guess it.
Twenty people have tried this today. Two left crying. One left a plant.
I am just here for moral support. I am very calm.
Hello. I am the exam. I have been on this desk all week, thinking about what I have seen.
Okay. Easy one. Did anyone in the class get a hundred?
One person.
Was it me?
Would you like to sit down?
I am sitting down.
Sit down more.
That is fine. A hundred is a lot of points. Nobody needs all of them.
Was my exam in the top half of the pile?
The pile fell over. Some of them were on the floor.
Some of us chose the floor.
Did you need a coffee after reading mine?
I switched to tea halfway through the pile. Tea is for grief.
Okay. Okay. Question four. Did I get question four right?
Question four asked how far away the moon is.
And I said?
Pretty far. You can see it from the parking lot.
That is technically true. I have seen it from the parking lot.
Did the exam make you laugh at any point?
Out loud. In a library. A man asked me to leave.
He was right to ask. It was a big laugh.
Is my grade a letter you can say in front of your mother?
My mother is a very understanding woman.
That is not a yes.
She has heard many letters.
Look, a letter is just a shape. You are more than a shape.
Leo, why are you so calm? You took the same exam.
I studied with flashcards. I made forty of them. With little drawings.
Mm.
Is there anything written on the back of my exam?
There is a drawing.
A drawing of what?
A horse. On the moon. Wearing my tie.
I would never draw a horse on an exam. I cannot draw horses.
It is not a good horse. It has five legs. One of them is the moon.
Five legs is a choice. An artistic choice.
Last question. Am I failing astronomy?
Imani. You never asked me which exam I was talking about.
What?
I was never yours, darling. I belong to him.
Your exam is in the drawer. It is the one person with a hundred.
I got a hundred? Then why did you need tea?
Because he sat right behind you, and he still wrote pretty far.
I was very calm because I did not know.
Now he knows.
Professor. I would like to guess my grade.
Would you like to sit down?
I am sitting down.
Sit down more.
Wait. Was the horse in your tie for me? Like a thank you?
It was a thank you. For the free tea at office hours.
I made a copy for my fridge. It is the best thing on my fridge.
So is that extra points?
It is zero points. But it is a very good fridge.
Is it a letter I can say in front of my mother?
It is not a letter, darling. It is a horse.
